glosses: im Voraus sorgend, meist um Probleme zu vermeiden

examples.text: Ich habe vorsorglich alle Putzmittel in die oberen Schränke getan.
Karl-Heinz holte sich schon am Sonnabend vorsorglich seine Eintrittskarte.
„Vor zwei Jahren mußte ich mein Brustimplantate vorsorglich entfernen lassen: wegen des Krebsrisikos der Silikoneinlagen.“
„Ich werde meinen Freund heiraten. Aber nur, wenn wir vorsorglich für den Fall, dass es doch zur Scheidung kommt, einen Ehevertrag schliessen.“
Eine große Flutwelle drohte [nachdem eine Gerölllawine den Fluß Kali Gandaki aufstaute]. […] Das größte Wasserkraftwerk Nepals […] wurde vorsorglich abgeschaltet.

[Nach einer Panne mit dem gefährlichen Milzbranderreger Anthrax] seien für [22 Armee-Mitglieder] "vorsorglich medizinische Maßnahmen" einschließlich der Verabreichung von Antibiotika getroffen worden.

translations.source_sense_description: im Voraus sorgend, meist um Probleme zu vermeiden

glosses: Of, pertaining to, or serving as a precaution.

examples.text: The port cities were quarantined as a precautionary measure, though no cases of the disease had been found.
Fearing attack on the northern ports by the English, he even took precautionary measures by strengthening the defense of Shan-hai-kuan 山海關 and Ch‘in-huang-tao 秦皇島.
Thou seest, Belford, by the above precautionaries, that I forget nothing.

translations.source_sense_description: im Voraus sorgend, meist um Probleme zu vermeiden

glosses: Preventing, hindering, or acting as an obstacle to.

examples.text: ...and I sometimes think whether, like the ancient king, it would not be prudent to make an offering to destiny, and throw my set of emeralds into the lake." Emily could not but deprecate the emeralds being destined to any such preventive service;...

glosses: Carried out to deter military aggression.
Slowing the development of an illness; prophylactic.

examples.text: Physick is either curative or preventive.
Any previous counsel or preventive understanding.

glosses: A thing that prevents, hinders, or acts as an obstacle to.

examples.text: Dogs should be warmly but airily housed; heartily, but not heatingly, fed — old Indian meal, mixed with oatmeal, suppawn, is the best general food, with a small quantity of salt, which is a preventive against worms […]

glosses: A thing that slows the development of an illness.

examples.text: Eaten with sugar yaourt is very palatable and refreshing in warm weather and is said to be a preventive of fever.
